user.title: Alexa Energy Display
user.description: Name the display. For the home screen widget, paste the skill's **Alexa Skill Messaging** client ID and secret from the Alexa developer console (Build → Tools → Permissions). Leave both empty to use only the full-screen view.

sources.title: Data sources
sources.description: Choose what to show. The Energy dashboard option reads live power and today's totals from Settings → Dashboards → Energy. Any other entities are added as tiles. The widget shows the first four tiles; the full-screen view shows up to twelve.

data.entities_first: Show extra entities before energy tiles

error.incomplete_credentials: Enter both the client ID and the client secret, or neither.
error.invalid_auth: Amazon rejected the client ID or secret.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Login with Amazon.
error.no_sources: Enable the Energy dashboard or choose at least one entity.
